suhada: [ su + hadaya = hara + ya. Ya - kye. Ṇvādi. 142. Nirutti. 559. ]  CL=7 See - suhajja.
suhadajjana: [ suhadaya + jana. Suhadayjana = suhadajjana. ] (pu) CL=7 One who has a good heart.
suhadamitta: [ suhada + mitta ] (pu) CL=7 A friend with a good heart.
suhadamitthavaṇṇanā: [ suhadamitta + vaṇṇanā ] (thī) CL=7 The commentary of a good-hearted friend.
suhadamittādivaṇṇanā: [ suhadamitta + ādi + vaṇṇanā ] (thī) CL=7 The commentary of a good-hearted friend.
suhadayamitta: [ suhadaya + mitta ]  CL=7 See - suhada - mitta.
suhadayasahāya: [ suhadaya + sahāya ] (pu) CL=7 A friend or companion with a good heart.
suhajja: [ su + hadaya + ṇya. Suhadaya = suhadya = suhajja. Suṭṭhu hadayametesanti katvā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 202. Suhadaya + ṇya. Ya - kye. Nirutti. 559. Suhadayabhā-vena suhajjā ca. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 191. Suṭṭhu hadayaṃ antokaraṇaṃ yassāti suhajjo, pasatthamano, hadayālu. Kappadduma. Suhasdaya - saṃ. Sahadda - prā. ] (ti) CL=7 A good friend with a kind heart.
suhajjakula: [ suhajja + kula ] (na) CL=7 A family of kind-hearted individuals.
suhajjañātimaṇḍala: [ suhajja + ñāti + maṇḍala ] (na) CL=7 A group of relatives of kind-hearted individuals.
suhanna: [ su + hada +ta. Nīti, dhātu. 93, 312. ] (na) CL=7 Properly defecated.
suhanusuhanū: [ su + hana = hana + u.ṇvādi. 2. Suhanu -saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) A Suhanu horse with a good chin. (2) Suhanujātaka, Jātaka 158 (JA158).
suhanujātaka: [ suhanu + jātaka ] (na) CL=7 While the Lord Buddha dwelled at the Jetavana Monastery, he preached a story about rough bhikkhus.
suhanujātakavaṇṇanā: [ suhanujātaka + vaṇṇanā ] (thī) CL=7 The commentary on the Suhanujātaka.
suhata: [ su + hana +ta. Nīti, dhātu. 113-4. Nīti, sutta. 1223. ] (ti) CL=7 Seriously beaten or struck.
[ suhata + bhāva. Bhāvalopa ] (ti) CL=7 The state of having been well killed or thoroughly destroyed.
suhaṭa: [ su + hata =hara +ta. Ta-kiu ṭa- pru. Nirutti. 45. Suhata-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 Well-brought or carried.
suhemanta: [ su + hemanta. Suhemanta-saṃ. Koṅaḥsochoṅaḥ - utu - rāsī. Vīlyaṃ. ] (pu) CL=7 (1) A thera named Suhemanta. (2) The verse of the venerable Suhemanta.
suhemantattheragāthā: [ suhemanta + thera + gāthā ] (thī) CL=7 The verse chanted by the venerable Suhemanta.
suhemantattheragāthāvaṇṇanā: [ suhemantattheragāthā + vaṇṇanā ] (thī) CL=7 The commentary of the verse of the venerable Suhemanta.
suhemā: [ su + hemā ] (thī) CL=7 A golden ruddy shelduck bird named Suhemā.
suhita: [ su + hita = dhā +ta. Dha - kiu ha-pru. Rū. 306-nhā. Moga, 5. 103. Suhita -saṃ. Suhia - prā. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Satisfied for food. (2) Content or peaceful.
suhitakāla: [ suhita + kāla ] (pu) CL=7 A time of being satiated or a time of satisfaction.
suhitayāvadatthatāgahaṇa: [ suhita + yāvadatthatā + gahaṇa ] (na) CL=7 Grasping or taking satisfaction according to one’s needs.
suhitākāra: [ suhita + ākāra ] (pu) CL=7 The quality of being satisfied or the aspect of satisfaction.
suhuju: [ su + uju = aja + u. Uju + kvi. Ha - lā. Dhāna, ṭī. 708. Nīti, dhātu. 47. Nīti, sutta. 56. Rū. 37. Suriju -saṃ. Suujju - prā. ] (ti) CL=7 One who is upright or an upright person.
suhuta: [ su + huta= hu + ta. Nīti, dhātu. 191. Suhuta - saṃ. Suhuya - prā, addhamāgadhī. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Properly offered. (Na) (2) Properly offering.
suhuṭṭhita: [ su + uṭṭhita = u + ṭhā +ta. Ha - lā. Nīti, dhātu. 55. Nīti, sutta. 56. ] (na) CL=7 A good awakening or a good rising.
